description: Swept-sine frequency response of the VCM actuator of drive D1, VCM current to head position, exported by the servo analyzer (demo).

firmware_controller.form: C(z) = lead K (s/wz + 1)/(s/wp + 1) x integral (s + wi)/s x notch (f0, depth_dB, zeta_p); corner frequencies in Hz; Tustin, prewarped (labs/07_hdd/_model.py controller())

true_model: y/u = Kp [1/s^2 + sum r_i/(s^2 + 2 zeta_i w_i s + w_i^2)] (tracks/A), sampled with a zero-order hold and a computation delay tau; see labs/07_hdd/_model.py

test.excitation: stepped swept sine added to the controller output (track following, firmware controller in the loop)
test.amplitude: 0.6 mA up to 1 kHz, then rising as f^2, at most 8 mA
test.estimate: excitation as reference: G = H(exc -> position)/H(exc -> current); synchronous runout removed before the correlation; coherence between excitation and position
